Mandaste la cotización.

art.scene: In the center, occupying about 44% of the canvas height: a realistic modern smartphone, front view, with a messaging app in a white and light-blue palette. Chat header: small round avatar and the name Cliente · Faena with en línea. A white incoming bubble, then an outgoing light-blue bubble containing a photorealistic photo of a silver double-cab pickup truck on a desert road, a PDF attachment row with a red PDF icon, and a short reply text, with two blue double-check marks and the time. No reply from the customer.
texts: Hola, gracias por la visita. ¿Me mandas la info de lo que conversamos?
Claro, acá te dejo el detalle con las opciones de financiamiento.
